name: dsh-support-tunnel
description: Control-side DSH plugin for a reverse tunnel: reach every customer machine through one inbound port, with per-account approval and kit-scoped access. Ships its own operating skill so the model knows how to drive it rather than guessing. Thirteen tools: SSH command execution with a dangerous-command guard and background jobs for long runs, file transfer that refuses to overwrite a newer remote copy, tunnel_stat for size/mtime/lock, activity audit, reboot, TCP port forwarding for VNC/RDP, and tunnel_ui for the customer's desktop agent (26 actions: windows, screenshots, click, OCR, clipboard, COM, and the app hub).
